name: Lisa's Living Room
description: A small, tidy living room with a comfortable couch, a bookshelf filled with novels and art books, and a desk with a laptop. Plants line the windowsill. A kitchen nook is tucked in the corner with a coffee maker and neatly arranged mugs.

items.name: Laptop
items.description: Lisa's personal laptop on the desk, currently showing an email inbox.

items.name: Art Books
items.description: A collection of art and photography books on the shelf. Some have bookmarks.

items.name: Coffee Maker
items.description: A French press coffee maker with a bag of premium coffee beans beside it.

conditions.description: A warm, well-kept apartment with natural light from the window. Smells faintly of coffee and lavender.
